verdict.rationale: Event-triggered automation rules are a fair question for a developer-platform mobile client. However, nothing in the evidence shows GitHub Mobile itself letting users define rules that fire actions on events. The app's documented features are reviewing, triaging, notifications, and starting or tracking Copilot agent tasks by hand. Event-based automations (Copilot cloud agent automations, GitHub Actions) are documented only as GitHub.com host-platform features, so they earn no credit for the mobile app.
